question: The most famous of all Jain festivals, Mahamastakabhisheka is performed every 12 years at the Digambara sacred complex at _____ in Karnataka.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shravanabelagola**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shravanabelagola** is the location where the **Mahamastakabhisheka festival **is performed every **12 years**.
 
• This festival is one of the most significant events for the Jain community and attracts devotees from all over the world.
